caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, brown jug with a rounded body that tapers toward a narrow, short neck and a slightly flared rim. The jug is positioned upright and centrally on a plain, beige background. The surface of the jug has a smooth, even texture and is shaded to suggest light and shadow, giving it a three-dimensional appearance. Across the upper part of the jug, just below the neck, there is a decorative blue-black design consisting of stylized floral or leaf motifs and curved lines. Between these designs, the words "JOHN HAV" are written in bold, dark blue-black capital letters. Beneath this inscription, there is a smaller marking that appears to be the letters "f·c" in the same blue-black color. The background is otherwise unadorned, and the artist's name, JESSICA RICE, is faintly inscribed in the lower left corner.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
